killedBy: the self-test takes the pad off the menu (issue #599) consumes and drops every gamepad action except Back while the pane is open
why: `gamepad-menu.ts` reads button 0 as Confirm and the left stick as the four directions. Without this the two buttons a tester most needs to identify activate a control and walk the focus ring instead of moving the readout -- the pane cannot test the controls it is most asked about.
